call_sites.text: the live arm of _crew routes through project_live_rows, and it is the only production caller in the tree

findings.text: the landing note's claim "No new lint findings in the three edited files against base a130260c (21 against 22 at base)" is false of the change it describes: measuring the same two production files with the repo's own ruff configuration gives 18 findings at a130260c and 19 at 215821ed, and the added one is created by this change -- inserting `from reckon.crew.query import project_live_rows` between the RunQueryError and runs_view imports of the same module leaves reckon/mcp.py:51:1 "I001 Import block is un-sorted or un-formatted", which `ruff check --select I001 --diff` resolves by merging the two reckon.crew.query lines into one; the repo's own rule is that a commit adds no findings, and this one adds exactly one, auto-fixable.

the gate measure is recorded as run at head d5773b49 (repeated at docs/plans/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling.html:101), but the durable log beside the run -- gate-live-honours-fields.log -- carries "head: 215821ed12b5e88b3b34f0828dadc48cfdf51dab" and "base: a130260c4ad33e9e9cc9bcfab207f7e9286a30e0"; the two revisions are code-identical (215821ed changes only the two documents), so the reading stands at both, but the record names a revision its own log does not.

item_verdicts.call_sites: one production call site -- reckon/mcp.py:3572, the live arm of _crew, routed through project_live_rows -- plus five calls to mcp._crew in the test module; project_live_rows has no other caller in the tree.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base a130260c; 39dee90a adds the projection and the three-field widening to reckon/crew/query.py and routes mcp.py's live arm through it plus a 179-line test module, 8db64fe6 adds the plan note, the cumulative evidence anchor and a figure, d5773b49 fixes the live-field validation and the mine marker and deletes that figure, and 215821ed records the second defect in the note and the anchor; the net diff is five paths, and the four commit messages carry conventional subjects and bodies with no attribution trailer and no plan identifiers.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure asks for tests asserting the three behaviours on a synthetic config home with two live runs and for the live-view test to fail when the projection is removed, with that failure observed and its log recorded; I reran the gate at 215821ed in the reviewed tree (4 passed, EXIT=0) and independently re-applied the mutation in a scratch copy of the head, replacing project_live_rows with the pre-change classify_pointer loop in reckon/mcp.py, and observed exactly the recorded outcome -- the projection, mine and refusal tests fail while the runs test passes (3 failed, 1 passed) -- with the mutated module confirmed imported.
item_verdicts.goal: §4 asks for live rows carrying exactly the requested fields plus the run id, runs accepting log_age_seconds, commits_beyond_base and manifest_reported_status from the same classification live already computes, and an unknown field still refused naming the accepted set; all three are delivered in reckon/crew/query.py (project_live_rows, the widened OPTIONAL_RUN_FIELDS, the live-vocabulary refusal) and reckon/mcp.py:3572, and asserted by the four tests.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the manifest of r-20260924T211810703600-crew-live-honours-fields; status complete with the four commits, the gate command and its log path, and the negative-control log whose first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim; its follow_ons correctly reports an unrelated pre-existing failure (tests/test_crew_runs_scope.py) rather than folding it into this change.
item_verdicts.write_paths: six declared paths and five net changed paths, all inside the declared set: reckon/crew/query.py, reckon/mcp.py, the new test module, the scaled record and the plan note; the figure directory is declared and net-zero, added in 8db64fe6 and deleted in d5773b49, which is why it does not appear in the net diff.

justifications.durability: both halves are load-bearing under mutation: removing the live projection reds three tests, and reading the coordinator fields from the pointer record instead of the classification reds the fourth -- both mutations applied and observed by me.
justifications.evidence: the gate and negative-control observations are real and recorded with revision, tree and command headers, and I reproduced both the pass and the red run myself; two claims do not survive checking: the no-new-findings claim is false by one auto-fixable I001 this change introduces, and the recorded log's head is 215821ed while the note names d5773b49, code-identical so the reading stands at both.
justifications.fit: the new code follows the module's idioms -- frozen field tuples, RunQueryError, docstrings stating the mechanism, a named LIVE_ROW_ANCHOR -- and the refactor into _requested_field_names and _refuse_unknown_fields removes a duplicated normalisation; the live vocabulary read from the rows in hand with an empty-pointer fallback is the subtlest choice and is documented, though project_live_rows now carries classification, validation, marking and projection in one function.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every clause of §4 is present in the code and asserted; I verified the counts against the tree (classify_pointer({}) yields the 48 keys the record claims, DEFAULT_RUN_FIELDS is 15, 15+3 is 18, and the narrowed live row is 3), and the runs-side values are asserted equal to classify_pointer for the same pointer.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five net changed paths sit inside the six declared; no test file outside the new module, no sibling file touched; the figure was added and then removed within the declared figures path, with the removal explained in the commit body.
